job.title: Wireless Engineer
job.description:
Senior Wireless Network Engineer

Location: New York, NY
Schedule: Hybrid, 3 days onsite
Type: Contract to Hire
Start: ASAP

Overview

A growing organization is seeking a senior-level Wireless Network Engineer with strong hands-on Wi-Fi expertise.

This is not a traditional route/switch role. The focus is heavily on wireless troubleshooting, RF design, Meraki, and supporting a large, high-density multi-site environment.

The role is roughly 80% operational troubleshooting and 20% project work.

Must Haves

  • Strong Cisco Meraki wireless experience
  • Advanced Wi-Fi and RF troubleshooting
  • Cell sizing, radio profiles, power, channels, and AP placement
  • Experience with 5 GHz and 6 GHz environments
  • High-density wireless experience
  • Ability to troubleshoot independently
  • Strong communication and teamwork
  • Proactive, hands-on mindset

Environment

  • Cisco Meraki
  • Some Cisco enterprise wireless
  • Modern Wi-Fi environments, including newer wireless standards
  • Large multi-site footprint
  • High-density user environments
  • Continued location growth and expansion

What They Want

Someone who can walk into a difficult Wi-Fi issue, investigate independently, and identify the root cause.

The right person will also look beyond the immediate problem, identify improvements, document processes, and help mentor other technical team members.

Not a Fit

  • Generic route/switch engineers
  • Candidates with limited wireless depth
  • Candidates with no Meraki experience
  • Pure architects who are no longer hands-on

job.title: Technical Project Manager
job.description:
Technical Project Manager

Location: New York, NY
Schedule: Hybrid

Lead. Connect. Build.

We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to join a dynamic technology environment and play a key role connecting business stakeholders, engineering teams, and technical leadership.

This is an opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology and business — someone who can take a business need, understand the technical requirements behind it, and turn it into clear, actionable work for an engineering team.

You’ll work closely with software engineers and senior technology leaders, helping drive projects forward, bring structure to complex initiatives, and ensure everyone is aligned from idea through execution.

If you're technically curious, highly organized, and enjoy being the person who keeps teams moving in the right direction, this could be a great fit.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partner with engineering leadership and business stakeholders to plan and execute technical initiatives

  • Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements

  • Translate business needs into clear technical tickets, user stories, tasks, and acceptance criteria

  • Work closely with software engineers to ensure requirements are understood and actionable

  • Manage and organize technical work throughout the development lifecycle

  • Track priorities, project progress, dependencies, risks, and outstanding action items

  • Facilitate communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Help teams stay aligned on scope, priorities, timelines, and deliverables

  • Participate in project planning, status meetings, and technical discussions

  • Maintain clear and organized project documentation

  • Communicate project updates and technical considerations to senior stakeholders

  • Identify gaps, blockers, and dependencies and help drive them toward resolution

What We're Looking For

We’re open to candidates with different professional backgrounds who have experience working closely with technology or software development teams.

Your previous title might be:

  • Technical Project Manager

  • IT Project Manager

  • Technical Program Manager

  • Project Manager

  • Technical Business Analyst

  • Business Systems Analyst

  • Systems Analyst

  • Product Owner

  • Scrum Master

  • Project Coordinator

  • Implementation Manager

  • Software Development Project Manager

What matters most is your ability to understand technology, organize complex work, and communicate effectively across teams.

You'll Bring

  • Experience supporting projects within a technology, software, or engineering environment

  • Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC)

  • Experience gathering and documenting business and technical requirements

  • Experience creating or managing Jira tickets, user stories, technical tasks, or acceptance criteria

  • Strong ability to translate between technical and business audiences

  • Excellent organization and attention to detail

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and stakeholders

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Confidence working with engineers, business leaders, and senior stakeholders

  • Experience working in an Agile / Scrum environment

Technical Experience Is a Plus

You don't need to be a software engineer to succeed in this role.

We're particularly interested in candidates who have exposure to areas such as:

  • APIs and system integrations

  • Backend development concepts

  • Git / software repositories

  • Application architecture

  • Development and deployment workflows

  • Jira or similar project/ticketing platforms

  • Agile / Scrum methodologies

  • Cloud technologies

  • Enterprise applications and systems

Why This Opportunity?

This is more than a traditional project management role.

You'll sit directly between business strategy and technical execution, working with engineering teams while gaining visibility into how technology initiatives are planned, prioritized, and delivered.

It’s an opportunity to take ownership, work with experienced technical leaders, and continue building your understanding of software development and modern technology environments.

If you’re a Technical PM, IT Project Manager, Business Analyst, Scrum Master, or technical professional looking to take the next step in your career, we’d love to connect.

Apply today or reach out to learn more about the opportunity.

 

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ethnic origin, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

job.title: AV Support Tech
job.description:
AV Support Technician

Location: New Jersey
Work Type: On-Site / Flexible / As Needed
AV Professionals Wanted — Join Our Network

We’re expanding our network of AV professionals across New Jersey to support a variety of corporate audiovisual and collaboration technology needs.
This is a great opportunity for AV technicians who enjoy hands-on work, troubleshooting technology, supporting live meetings, and working in professional environments.
Some assignments may be recurring and scheduled, while others may be ad-hoc, event-based, or on-call depending on the needs of our clients. This flexibility makes the opportunity a great fit for experienced AV technicians looking to pick up additional work, build relationships with new organizations, or stay active in the AV industry.
You’ll have the opportunity to work with modern collaboration technology and support everything from conference rooms and video conferencing to live events and webcasting.
What You Could Be Supporting
Depending on the assignment, responsibilities may include:

  • Supporting in-person, hybrid, and virtual meetings

  • Providing on-site AV and end-user support
  • Setting up and testing conference rooms before meetings and events
  • Troubleshooting audio, video, display, and connectivity issues
  • Supporting Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Webex, and other collaboration platforms
  • Performing basic troubleshooting and system fault isolation
  • Supporting live meetings, presentations, and virtual events
  • Assisting with webcasting and streaming events
  • Performing preventative maintenance on AV equipment
  • Supporting equipment installation, removal, and replacement
  • Updating software and maintaining AV systems
  • Providing hands-on assistance and training to end users
  • Coordinating with vendors and other technical teams when issues need to be escalated
  • Documenting service activity, troubleshooting steps, and completed work
  • Helping ensure meeting spaces are ready and fully operational

The Type of AV Professionals We're Looking For
We’re casting a wide net and are interested in connecting with AV professionals at different stages of their careers.
You may be a:

  • AV Technician
  • Audio Visual Technician
  • AV Support Technician
  • AV Specialist
  • Audiovisual Technician
  • Conference Room Technician
  • Collaboration Technician
  • Video Conferencing Technician
  • Field AV Technician
  • Event AV Technician
  • Corporate AV Technician
  • AV Engineer
  • Broadcast / Streaming Technician
  • Unified Communications Technician
  • IT Technician with strong AV experience

Experience With Any of These Is a Plus

  • Crestron
  • Extron
  • Cisco
  • Microsoft Teams
  • Zoom
  • Webex
  • Conference room systems
  • Video conferencing
  • Projectors and displays
  • Audio systems
  • Microphones and DSPs
  • Control systems
  • Webcasting and streaming
  • Digital signage
  • AV-over-IP
  • Equipment installation and troubleshooting

Why Join Our AV Network?
Not every AV opportunity looks the same — and that's the point.
Our team works with organizations that need reliable AV professionals they can count on, whether that's for ongoing support, a specific project, an important meeting, a live event, or an unexpected technical issue.
That means opportunities can range from scheduled on-site support to occasional ad-hoc assignments, depending on your experience, availability, and location.
It's an opportunity to:

  • Get exposure to different corporate AV environments
  • Work with modern collaboration technology
  • Take on projects that match your experience and availability
  • Build relationships with organizations and technical teams
  • Expand your AV experience across different environments
  • Stay connected to new opportunities in the New Jersey market
  • We're Interested in Meeting You
    If you're an AV technician who knows how to troubleshoot, work with customers, and keep technology running when it matters, we'd like to connect.
    Whether you're looking for consistent AV work, occasional assignments, project-based opportunities, or simply want to be considered when the right opportunity comes up, we'd love to add you to our network.
    Submit your resume today and let's start a conversation.

job.title: DataCenter Estimator
job.description:
Data Center Estimator

Location: Paramus, NJ (On Site)
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM

About the Role

We are seeking a Data Center Estimator to join our growing team in Paramus, NJ. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with hands-on data center infrastructure experience who is looking to transition into an office-based estimating role.

This is not a traditional estimating position. Our estimators are responsible for developing complete project estimates, including labor, materials, bills of materials (BOMs), takeoffs, and scopes of work for mission critical data center infrastructure projects. Success in this role requires the ability to understand how a project will be built and accurately estimate every component required for installation.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate labor and material estimates for data center infrastructure projects.

  • Develop bills of materials (BOMs), material takeoffs, and detailed scopes of work.

  • Review drawings, layouts, and customer requirements to build complete project estimates.

  • Conduct site surveys and gather project information as needed.

  • Work closely with project managers, sales, and operations to ensure accurate project pricing.

  • Proofread estimates for accuracy before submission.

  • Utilize Microsoft Excel and other internal estimating tools to prepare proposals.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience installing or estimating data center infrastructure.

  • Strong understanding of structured cabling, fiber optic and copper cabling systems.

  • Experience with ladder rack, cable tray, wire basket, strut/channel systems, server cabinets, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Ability to interpret drawings, Visio layouts, and project documentation.

  • Knowledge of labor estimating, material takeoffs, and bills of materials.

  • Experience with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, Bluebeam, SAP, and Visio is preferred.

  • Familiarity with industry estimating resources such as RSMeans, NECA, or similar is a plus.

  • Excellent attention to detail with strong written communication skills.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following will be highly regarded:

  • Data center construction

  • Structured cabling

  • Fiber optic installation

  • Mission critical facilities

  • Commercial or industrial electrical contracting

  • Low voltage systems

Field installation experience is highly preferred. We have found the most successful estimators are individuals who understand how data center infrastructure is physically built and can translate that experience into accurate estimates.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to work on complex, high-profile data center infrastructure projects with a company that specializes in mission critical environments. If you enjoy solving technical problems, have a strong understanding of data center construction, and are looking to grow your career in estimating, we'd like to hear from you.

 

 **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ethnic origin, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**
